bench.description: Compare jade's token cost against the shell arm across the benchmark scenarios

binary.description: Build the release binary into bin/jade-mcp and print its stamped version

docs-check.run: make binary >/dev/null && printf 'Content-Length: 58\r\n\r\n{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}' | ./bin/jade-mcp 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"jade\.[a-z_]*"' | sed 's/"jade\.//;s/"//' | sort -u > /tmp/jade-actual.txt; sed -n '/^## What Jade gives an agent/,/^## What Jade does not/p' README.md | grep -o '`[a-z_]*`' | tr -d '`' | sort -u > /tmp/jade-doc.txt; missing=$(comm -23 /tmp/jade-actual.txt /tmp/jade-doc.txt); if [ -n "$missing" ]; then echo "FAIL: tools not documented in README:"; echo "$missing"; exit 1; fi; echo "all tools documented"
docs-check.description: Fail if any MCP tool the binary serves is missing from the README tool list

fmt.description: Format all Go sources in place

fmt-check.description: List Go files that are not gofmt-clean; silent means clean

release-gate.run: set -e; make build; go vet ./...; go test ./...; test -z "$(gofmt -l ./cmd ./internal)" || { echo "gofmt: files need formatting"; gofmt -l ./cmd ./internal; exit 1; }; echo "release gate: all green"
release-gate.description: Everything that must pass before tagging a release: build, vet, test, gofmt

templates-check.run: for f in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yml; do ruby -ryaml -e "YAML.load_file(ARGV[0])" "$f" || { echo "FAIL: $f is not valid YAML"; exit 1; }; done; echo "all issue templates parse"
templates-check.description: Fail if any GitHub issue template is not valid YAML

vet.description: Run go vet across the module
